declarations.docstring: A nonzero invariant submodule contains the range of an injective equivariant map from a simple finite-dimensional representation.
The general linear group action on matrix polynomials preserves membership in the bounded-total-degree subspace.
A nonzero submodule that is finite-dimensional over the field contains a simple submodule.
Simplicity of a subrepresentation as a submodule implies simplicity of its associated representation module.
The module of a subrepresentation's associated representation is linearly equivalent to its underlying submodule.
